D/ CONSTANTI NVS MAX AVG ; R/ [GLOR IA EX]ERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Trier mint Gloria Exercitus issue of 332-333, Reece period 17; most likely RIC vol. 7 page 216 no. 538, issue of 332-333. Obverse description: Bust either pearl diademed or laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTI NVS MAX AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them.
